description: This Java class 'ModelServiceReader' reads and parses XML service definition files for the Apache OFBiz framework, creating in-memory representations of services, including their parameters, permissions, notifications, and other metadata.

classes.name: ModelServiceReader
classes.description: A final class responsible for reading and parsing XML service definition files, constructing ModelService objects with their configurations, permissions, notifications, and parameters.

methods.name: getModelServiceMap
methods.description: Static method to create a map of service names to ModelService objects from a URL or ResourceHandler.

methods.name: createModelService
methods.description: Creates a ModelService object from an XML Element representing a service.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Loads and parses an XML Document from a given URL.
